title: 第2031章 看不懂陆玄第2030章 苍兀老祖威胁
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “吕冰！你最好给我想好了！留给你的时间不多了！”
苍兀老祖狂暴的声音在星空震荡。
他真的忍无可忍了！
他的脚下重重一踏。
“咔嚓！”
虚空撕裂！
一条幽暗的深渊异象衍化了出来，撕天裂地，混沌一般的力量冲击十方。
天穹变得无比昏暗！
这股力量和吕冰的冰寒之力碰撞在一起。
两大场域在疯狂磨灭，炼化！
苍兀老祖身上杀意沸腾，“吕冰，我真想弄死你啊！”
吕冰冷笑了起来，“好啊，来啊！”
而两人下方，两方势力再次激战在一起。
天地震荡！
与此同时，大昌星域。
幽林长老收起黑色圆盘，突然看向璇玑圣主。
他做出了一个选择。
“冥，你不能有事。现在陆玄来了，我们只能当苍兀老祖降临。但我们能撑到什么时候？”
“所以，你必须走！”
“我让噬魂长老他们带着你走！”
璇玑圣主美眸微蹙。
本来还想和师父说说话呢。
不过这的确是一个离开的机会。
她默默点头。
幽林长老手中灵诀变幻。
“哧哧哧！”
一股浩荡的空间之力突然出现，向着璇玑圣主的身上落下。
同时，噬魂长老等人身上也出现空间之力。
幽林长老秘声传音，“噬魂，马上带着璇玑圣主离开大昌星域。”
噬魂长老皱眉，“去哪里？”
“前往蛊族的阵地。”幽林长老一脸凝重道，“陆玄他们不会这么快降临那里！”
噬魂长老点头，“好。”
他也意识到眼下情况十分紧急。
下一瞬。
璇玑圣主和噬魂长老等人消失在原地。
幽林长老为了给他们争取时间，直接拂袖一挥，下令道。
“黑龙，暗虎，血木！出手！杀陆玄！”
声音落下！
黑龙长老，暗虎长老和血木长老互相看了一眼。
他们是除了幽林长老最强的了！
现在有大昌星域的诡异大阵加持，他们可以爆发最强的力量。
能不能挡住陆玄？
他们已经没有选择了！
只能强行出手！
content_en:
"Lu Bing! You'd better think about it! You don't have much time left!"
The violent voice of Patriarch Cangwu vibrated in the starry sky.
He really couldn't bear it anymore!
His foot stomped hard.
"Crack!"
The void is torn apart!
A dark abyss vision emerged, tearing the sky and the earth apart, and the power of chaos impacted in all directions.
The sky becomes extremely dark!
This power collided with Lu Bing's cold power.
The two fields are being destroyed and refined like crazy!
Ancestor Cangwu's body was boiling with murderous intent, "Lu Bing, I really want to kill you!"
Lu Bingbing laughed, "Okay, come on!"
Below the two people, the two forces were fighting fiercely together again.
The world shook!
At the same time, Dachang Star Territory.
Elder Youlin put away the black disk and suddenly looked at Holy Lord Xuanji.
He made a choice.
"Ming, nothing can happen to you. Now that Lu Xuan is here, we can only treat it as the ancestor of Cangwu. But how long can we last?"
"So, you have to go!"
"I'll let Elder Soul Eater and the others take you away!"
Holy Lord Xuanji frowned slightly.
I originally wanted to talk to Master.
But this is indeed an opportunity to leave.
She nodded silently.
The spiritual secret in Elder Youlin's hand changes.
"Chichichi!"
A mighty force of space suddenly appeared and fell towards Holy Lord Xuanji.
At the same time, the power of space also appeared on Elder Soul Eater and others.
Elder Youlin secretly said, "Soul Eater, take Holy Lord Xuanji and leave the Dachang Star Territory immediately."
The soul-eating elder frowned, "Where to go?"
"Go to the Gu tribe's position." Elder Youlin said with a solemn expression, "Lu Xuan and the others will not come there so soon!"
The soul-eating elder nodded, "Okay."
He also realized that the situation was very urgent.
The next moment.
"Phew!"
Holy Lord Xuanji, Elder Soul Eater and others disappeared from the spot.
In order to buy them time, Elder Youlin waved his sleeves and gave the order.
"Black dragon, dark tiger, blood wood! Take action! Kill Lu Xuan!"
The sound falls!
Elder Black Dragon, Elder Dark Tiger and Elder Bloodwood looked at each other.
Apart from Elder Youlin, they are the strongest!
Now with the blessing of the strange formation in Dachang Star Region, they can explode with the strongest power.
Can you stop Lu Xuan?
They have no choice!
We can only take action by force!
